ms.report:
We are pleased to announce the successful completion of Milestone 4 and the final for the Dolos: Cardano Data Node project. 
Note on v0.6 tag
It's important to clarify that despite the comprehensive features and readiness for use by developers, we have decided to tag this release as v0.6 instead of v1 as initially described in the proposal. This decision is essentially a formality and does not reflect the completeness or capability of the current version.
This tagging decision is related to the ongoing changes in the library API, primarily due to the introduction of Phase-1 validations that were approved in Fund 10. As these validations are integrated into Dolos, they will inevitably lead to breaking changes in the library.
To avoid potential confusion or the need to maintain two Long-Term Support (LTS) branches of the source code, we have reserved the v1 tag for the version where the API is stable. This approach ensures that when developers see a v1 tag, they can be confident they are working with a version of Dolos where the API is not expected to undergo significant changes.
However, it's important to reiterate that the v0.6 release is fully functional and includes all the features described in the original proposal. Developers can confidently use this version, knowing it delivers the promised functionality and efficiency.
Fully Functional Binary Release: 
The culmination of our efforts is evident in the fully functional binary release. You can now download and install Dolos, which is ready to empower Cardano data management needs. The binary release is available for download at https://github.com/txpipe/dolos .

Publicly Available Source Code: 
In our commitment to transparency, we have made the source code that matches the v0.6 binary release openly available for review, customization, and contributions. You can access the codebase at https://github.com/txpipe/dolos .
